x402.solana-transaction-share-30d.definition: Solana's share of x402 transactions across all chains tracked by x402scan, last 30 days.
x402.solana-transaction-share-30d.note: Replaces the published 76%: 781,624 of 3,776,966 x402 transactions over 30 days were on Solana (27.7% all time).

x402.solana-transactions-all-time.definition: All-time x402 transactions on Solana tracked by x402scan.

x402.solana-buyers-and-sellers-all-time.definition: All-time unique x402 buyers plus unique sellers on Solana, per x402scan. An address can be both, so this is an upper bound on participants.

x402.solana-volume-share-30d.definition: Solana's share of x402 USD payment volume across all chains tracked by x402scan, last 30 days.
x402.solana-volume-share-30d.note: Replaces the published 70%: $339,667 of $1,533,733 over 30 days.
